brand.name: BeauGlow India
brand.tone: Premium, elegant, soft, cultural, natural, glowing

surfaces.product_card: bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-1 border border-transparent hover:border-[#d4af37]/20

components_strategy.header: Sticky nav with glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md). Includes Logo, Nav Links, Search, Wishlist, Cart.
components_strategy.hero: Large elegant banner. Use subtle zoom-in parallax effect. Text overlays should have high contrast or a soft gradient behind text to preserve readability over images.
components_strategy.buttons: Primary: bg-[#d4af37] text-white hover:bg-[#b8952a] rounded-full px-8 py-3 transition-colors. Secondary: border-2 border-[#d4af37] text-[#d4af37] hover:bg-[#d4af37] hover:text-white rounded-full.
components_strategy.forms_inputs: Shadcn components with rounded-full or rounded-xl edges, soft borders border-[#e8d8d0], focus:ring-[#d4af37].
components_strategy.badges: bg-[#f8d7da] text-[#332211] font-medium text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-full
components_strategy.whatsapp_chat: Fixed bottom-right corner, circular floating action button, subtle pulse animation.

animations.entrance: Framer Motion staggered fade-in up (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1) for lists and grids.
animations.hover: Smooth scale up (1.05) on product images, subtle shadow increase on cards.

hero_banner.description: Indian woman with glowing skin, minimal gold jewelry, beige background

offer_banner.description: Festive Indian beauty products flat lay, glowing gold accents

products.description: Premium cosmetic bottle on soft pink silk background
Collection of premium skincare cosmetic bottles, glass and gold caps

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #332211 or #5c4a3d text over #f8d7da or #f5e6da meets 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML tags alongside Tailwind for complex marketing layouts; utilize Shadcn mainly for complex interactive components (Select, Dialog, Form).
Avoid generic borders. Use soft shadows or very subtle colored borders (#e8d8d0) for cards.
Implement Framer Motion for scroll stagger animations on grids (Categories, Products).
Hero section should feel premium; if overlaying text on the image, use a subtle radial gradient or soft background overlay to ensure the Playfair text remains highly legible.
Create dummy products based on the provided media URLs. Map images to 'Eye Makeup', 'Face Makeup', 'Skincare', 'Hair Care', 'Bridal Collection'.
Theme is primarily LIGHT, capturing an 'Organic & Earthy' yet 'Luxurious' feel. Do not use dark mode globally.
Include a 'WhatsApp Chat' button floating fixed at the bottom right corner.
Include Google Fonts 'Playfair Display' and 'Poppins' in the index.html or global css.
